settings.heading: Settings

locale.label: App language
locale.description: Menus, messages and the names of newly created ready-made note types use this language. Your cards' content does not change.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Light, dark, or follow the system setting.

show_advanced.label: Show advanced features
show_advanced.description: When on, settings and menus also show the rarely needed pages. When off nothing is deleted; search still finds them.

settings.general_intro: Pick the app's language and look here. Not sure where a setting lives? Start with the questions below.

conflict.history_barrier: Undo stops here: the collection was replaced from a backup or the trash was emptied for good. Earlier history can't be undone.
conflict.module_required: This module can't be turned off.
conflict.deleted: This item is in the trash.

io.disk_full: The disk is full, so this was not saved. Free up some space and try again; the app keeps working.

shell.route_off: That page isn’t available right now; you can turn its module on in Settings › Modules.
